notes: This file tracks whether current active diagnostics are driven by corpus material, MS-VBAL/spec evidence, or oracle observations.
Legacy Markdown corpus files are pending-verification and must not be used as sole evidence for hard diagnostics.
Observed-only oracle cases may guide discovery, but they do not justify hard analyzer behavior until promoted.

diagnostics.notes: Project-backed unknown-call uses ProjectIndex.visibleProcedureNames(moduleName), so only same-module procedures and exported standard-module procedures are treated as bare callable names. Private procedures in other modules and object-module members do not suppress the diagnostic.

Active rule covers project-backed Option Explicit write/read positions: bare assignment and Set targets, RHS and call-argument reads, control-flow block headers, member receivers, and indexed bases. Runtime constants and generated Excel enum constants suppress false positives. Type-name, label, named-argument, and unresolved external-style call positions remain intentionally silent until the binder can prove broader reference shapes without false positives.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 3.3.5.2 reserved identifiers are not IDENTIFIER tokens
diagnostics.notes: Flags unbracketed reserved identifiers in declaration-name positions. Bracketed FOREIGN-NAME forms remain accepted.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle cases plus deterministic project signature graph
diagnostics.notes: Same-module signatures come from the AST. Cross-module checks run only for exported standard-module Sub/Function signatures supplied by ProjectIndex. Ambiguous bare exported names stay silent; module-qualified calls resolve through the named standard module only. Source-backed and host member signatures are validated through the shared member binder for parenthesized calls and parenless member call statements.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE literal, return-type, numeric-expression, string-concatenation, and project signature model
diagnostics.notes: This is not a VBE compile-equivalent error: the focused compile oracle case compiles successfully. It is red because focused runtime oracle cases deterministically raise runtime error 13 for nonnumeric string literals passed to numeric parameters, while numeric-string controls run successfully. Cross-module checks use exported standard-module project Sub/Function signatures; ambiguous bare names stay silent, while module-qualified calls resolve through the named standard module only. Source-backed and host member signatures feed the same argument type path for parenthesized calls and parenless member call statements.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic XLIDE object-parameter compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error: the focused oracle case is rejected with Type mismatch.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE scalar assignment compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: This is not a VBE compile-equivalent error: focused compile oracle cases compile successfully. It is red when XLIDE proves a literal cannot be coerced because focused runtime oracle cases deterministically raise runtime error 13, while numeric/string/Boolean/property/public-field controls run successfully. Function and Property Get return-name assignments use the same deterministic scalar path.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: VBA Function/Property Get return-variable semantics plus XLIDE type-safety policy
diagnostics.notes: VBA permits a Function or Property Get to fall through without assigning its return variable, which returns the default value for the declared type. XLIDE surfaces this as a warning, not a compile-equivalent error.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.3 Set statement plus deterministic XLIDE object assignment compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: Only known object variable, Function/Property Get return-name, and member targets with deterministic RHS types are flagged. Same project class, Nothing, generic Object, Variant/unknown types, and explicit Implements compatibility remain accepted.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic source-backed project class member model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error when the receiver resolves to a workbook class and source proves the member has no setter. Public constants are not object members in VBE; public constant declarations in object modules fail at the declaration.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic source-backed project class member model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error for workbook class receivers whose source-backed member surface is known and unambiguous. Public fields are valid members. Host/object-model and ambiguous receiver cases remain silent unless the receiver surface is exhaustive. Host events are not callable object members, so event names are excluded from object-member surfaces and can be reported absent when the receiver surface is exhaustive. Object and Variant receivers remain silent even when completion can refine them from simple Set assignments because VBE leaves those calls late-bound.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE numeric-expression compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: This is an error but not VBE compile-equivalent: the focused compile oracle case compiles successfully, while runtime oracle probes for nonnumeric string arithmetic deterministically raise runtime error 13. Operand-order, grouping, and multiplication variants reject; numeric-string, &-concatenation, and string-plus-string + controls run successfully.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle case for bare variable statement
diagnostics.notes: The argument-bearing local-variable call shape is observed-only until promoted; the active rule remains justified by call-statement target resolution.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.2.3.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle case for a trailing identifier after an As type name
diagnostics.notes: The active rule only fires after XLIDE parses a complete declaration type name and then sees an additional same-statement token outside valid declaration separators/defaults. Fixed-length string syntax remains out of scope until its full grammar is verified.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle for public object-module declaration restrictions
diagnostics.notes: The active rule is module-kind-sensitive and only fires for explicit Public constants, arrays, fixed-length strings, user-defined Types, and Declare statements in object modules. Standard modules and non-public declarations remain outside this rule.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel document-module event binding model plus XLIDE guidance policy
diagnostics.notes: Information-only guidance for known workbook/worksheet event-handler-shaped Sub declarations outside the matching document module. The procedure may still compile as an ordinary procedure, so this is not a compile-equivalent red diagnostic.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus MS-VBAL reserved-name/type-identifier distinction
diagnostics.notes: Broad unknown type-name diagnostics are deferred to the project-wide binder and external-reference story. The active rule uses the shared type-position scanner/resolver and only flags unresolved reserved/runtime names, visible project declarations known not to be types, and ambiguous visible project type names.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.3 Set statement plus deterministic XLIDE object type binding
diagnostics.notes: Only known object variables, Function/Property Get return names, and unambiguous source-backed object-valued members are flagged. Variant, unknown, and ambiguous project-member targets remain silent until the binder can prove the target shape.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic XLIDE scalar variable type environment
diagnostics.notes: Only known intrinsic scalar targets are flagged; unknown host/class object types are deferred to the object binder.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE scalar variable type environment
diagnostics.notes: Named member access on declared intrinsic scalar variables is rejected by VBE Compile as Invalid qualifier. Bare trailing-dot scalar statements are rejected by VBE Compile as Syntax error after explicit focus retesting. Only known intrinsic scalar receivers are flagged; Variant, Object, class, UDT, and unknown receiver types stay silent while they may be incomplete member-access completion contexts.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle cases for standalone empty-parentheses calls without Call
diagnostics.notes: VBE rejects standalone zero-argument calls such as myFunction(), ThisWorkbook.CanCheckIn(), Application.Calculate(), and ActiveSheet.Range() when they use empty parentheses without Call, while the same parenthesized call is valid in expression context or with the explicit Call keyword. Known same-module and exported standard-module procedures are resolved through the project procedure surface; unknown bare Foo() calls stay silent to avoid external-reference false positives. VBE also accepts non-empty standalone member/property forms such as Application.DeleteCustomList(1) and ActiveSheet.Range("A1"), so the active member-call rule is deliberately scoped to the empty-parentheses form.
